answer: Each agent must anchor itself to one funded identity by posting a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to honest work over many epochs. A clone fleet rolling in like a tide of fresh accounts earns no reputation cheaply: every fake sinks its own collateral and waits its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly. A raven-eyed verifier flags correlated funding trails and lockstep timing, forfeiting the stake of any swarm that betrays itself.
